from.place: Proof, second paragraph, sentence 'It is a regular ring, so bounded complexes with finite cohomology are perfect': the closure under triangle extensions used in the Tag 066U assembly after constructing perfect cohomology modules.

title: Perfect ring complexes are closed under triangle extensions
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $C_1\to C_2\to C_3\to C_1[1]$ be a distinguished triangle in the derived category $D(A)$ of $A$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. If $C_1$ and $C_3$ are perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], meaning isomorphic in $D(A)$ to bounded complexes of finitely generated projective $A$-modules, then $C_2$ is perfect.
